submission.rationale: The planning evidence shows the exact workspace tree was observed, reviewed as clean and judged ready to close, and the intended consequence is to close the Workspace. The owner contract allows workspace.close to compare-and-close one exact expectedSourceStateDigest, and the planning evidence provides that exact digest. There is no indication of a newer state changing the digest. Acting with the planning-time digest as the binding basis is the correct consequence, and it should commit against the owner.
